name: 2dai-mcp-server
description: MCP server for 2DAI — let Claude, Cursor, Cline and Windsurf generate images and video, upload references and organise your cloud drive on your own 2DAI account.

scripts.lint:stdout: ! grep -rnE 'console\.(log|info|debug|dir|table)\(' src/ || (echo 'stdout write in src/ corrupts the stdio JSON-RPC stream' && exit 1)
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint:stdout && npm run build
